introduction: The issue tool is a fifth command-line program (cmd/issue) exposing every operation of issuex.Client as a shell command, sharing the envelope, exit codes, report/events files and shared flags with the four existing tools (triage, fix, spec, impl) but requiring no model phase and making one forge call per invocation. Its domain logic lives in a new issueops/ package, and internal/toolio gains a no-model-phase execution path without duplicating the envelope, exit-code or emit logic.

glossary.envelope: The single JSON object every tool writes to stdout, defined by toolio.Envelope, carrying ok, status, exit_code, error, result, warnings, artifacts, side_effects, timings and next.
glossary.no-model-phase App: A toolio.App that declares it has no model phase; its execute path skips input classification, model resolution and runner construction.
glossary.operation: One of the 21 issuex.Client methods (Close excluded) selectable via --op, each making at most one forge API call.
glossary.target: The single positional argument naming what the operation acts on: a URL, owner/repo#N, owner/repo, a bare integer, or absent for repository-scoped operations.
glossary.trust tag: A Go struct tag (trust:"fact", trust:"external", trust:"model") classifying the provenance of a string field, walked by toolio.CheckTrust and toolio.UntrustedFields.

requirements.title: Program and package structure
requirements.rationale: A fifth tool must be buildable, installable and containerised on the same terms as the four existing ones, with its domain logic in its own package following the established pattern.

criteria.action: include issue in the Makefile TOOLS variable, the build and build-all targets, install.sh's TOOLS default, and the tools container Containerfile's build and COPY steps, so that make build, make build-all, install.sh and the container image each produce or install the issue binary alongside spec, triage, fix and impl
construct a toolio.App with Name "issue", delegate domain logic to the issueops/ package at the repository root, and call os.Exit(app.Main(...))

set the envelope's tool field to "issue", name report files issue-<started_at>-<session_id>.json, name events files issue-<started_at>-<session_id>.jsonl, and prefix stderr progress lines with "issue:"

requirements.title: Operation selection via --op
requirements.rationale: ADR 03 fixes every addition as a flag; --op with a DeclareEnum gives --schema a flat description and an MCP adapter a single input schema.

criteria.action: declare --op as an enum via DeclareEnum listing exactly 21 values: auth, repo, create, read, update, close, list, comment, comments, label, unlabel, create-label, create-pr, pr, files, pr-state, checks, reviews, review-comment, merge, close-pr

criteria.condition: --op <name> is provided
criteria.action: dispatch to the corresponding issuex.Client method for that operation name

criteria.condition: a run is invoked without --op and without --version or --schema
criteria.action: exit with code 2 and list all 21 operations in the error message

criteria.condition: --op auth is selected
criteria.action: report the forge type, API URL, authentication status and resolved repository without making any forge API call

requirements.title: Target parsing
requirements.rationale: The positional is what the operation acts on, not text to read; its shape is decided in Go before any request, and a mismatch is refused early.

criteria.action: accept a single positional whose shape is one of: a GitHub/GitLab issue or PR URL (parsed by issuex.ParseIssueURL), owner/repo#N or group/subgroup/project#N (a ref whose kind the operation decides), owner/repo or group/subgroup/project (parsed by issuex.ParseRepo, a repository), a bare positive integer N (a ref in the repository --repo names or the origin remote of --dir), or absent (the repository --repo names or the origin remote, accepted only by repository-scoped operations)
report the resolved target as result.target in the envelope and never set the input field

criteria.condition: the target's kind (issue vs PR vs repository) does not fit the selected operation
criteria.action: exit with code 2 and name the operation that would fit the given target kind

criteria.condition: --repo is given together with a URL or an owner/repo#N target that already names a repository
criteria.action: exit with code 2 reporting that --repo conflicts with the target's own repository

criteria.condition: a repository-scoped operation has no positional and no resolvable origin remote from --dir
criteria.action: exit with code 2 naming --repo as the remedy
criteria.contract: exit code 2, error.category is "usage", error.fix_hint.flag is "--repo"

requirements.title: Forge and credential resolution
requirements.rationale: The tool is a forge caller, not a model caller; it uses the same detectForge path as the four tools but must never fall back to a NoOpClient and must never read a vendor key.

criteria.action: build the forge client by calling issuex.NewWithOptions with the target's repository host, the origin remote of --dir, and the environment, following the same detectForge resolution path the four existing tools use for GITHUB_API_URL, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GITLAB_API_URL and GITLAB_TOKEN

criteria.condition: issuex.NewWithOptions returns an error or nil
criteria.action: report a failure with ok false and make no forge call; never fall back to issuex.NewNoOp()
criteria.contract: ok is false, no forge API call is made

criteria.condition: a write operation is requested and the client's Authenticated() returns false
criteria.action: refuse the request before any forge call, with error.category "auth", error.retryable false, and fix_hint.env listing GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN and GITLAB_TOKEN
criteria.contract: exit code 1, error.category is "auth", error.retryable is false, fix_hint.env contains three token variable names

criteria.condition: no token is set in the environment
criteria.action: run a read operation unauthenticated without reporting an auth error
never resolve a model, never read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or any vendor credential, and treat the absence of any vendor key as a non-error

criteria.condition: issuex.NewWithOptions returns ErrAmbiguousForge or ErrUnsupportedForge
criteria.action: report error.category "usage" with exit code 2 and fix_hint.env naming GITHUB_API_URL and GITLAB_API_URL
criteria.contract: exit code 2, error.category is "usage", fix_hint.env contains GITHUB_API_URL and GITLAB_API_URL

requirements.title: Flag set
requirements.rationale: The tool shares the shell's output and lifecycle flags but has no model phase, so model-run flags are refused early with a message naming the tools that do accept them.

criteria.action: register and accept the shared shell flags: --dir, --dry-run, --detail, --report-file, --output, --emit-events, --verbose, --quiet, --version, --schema

criteria.condition: any model-run flag (--model, --vendor, --effort, --max-turns, --budget, --phase-timeout, --total-budget, --context, --trust-project, --show-text, --input-kind, --preflight, --repo-map-tokens) is passed to issue
criteria.action: exit with code 2 with an error message naming the tools that accept the flag, using the unsupportedFlagMessage table
criteria.contract: exit code 2, error message names the accepting tools

criteria.action: check every own flag (--op, --repo, --title, --body, --body-file, --label, --assignee, --state, --sort, --direction, --limit, --color, --description, --head, --base, --draft, --method, --commit-title, --commit-message, --sha) against the selected operation in PreCheck before any forge call; a flag the operation does not take shall produce a usage error (exit 2)

criteria.condition: comment or review-comment is selected without --body or --body-file, create without --title, create-pr without --title or --head, update with no field to change, or label with no --label values
criteria.action: exit with code 2 before any forge call
criteria.contract: exit code 2, error.category is "usage", no forge API call is made

criteria.condition: --body-file produces an empty body after reading, or both --body and --body-file are provided
criteria.action: exit with code 2 before any forge call

requirements.title: Result type and output
requirements.rationale: The result must carry trust tags on every string field so untrusted_fields and CheckTrust work, and the summary view must trim only what a chaining caller does not need.

criteria.action: define a Result type with a fixed head (op trust:"fact", forge trust:"fact", api_url trust:"fact", authenticated bool, target trust:"fact", dry_run bool) and one section per operation present only for the operation that fills it, where titles and bodies carry trust:"external" and structural fields (state, URL, timestamps, login, labels) carry trust:"fact"; CheckRun.Summary, Review.Body and MergeResult.Message carry trust:"external"
populate untrusted_fields in the envelope with every non-empty external-tagged field by RFC 6901 JSON pointer rooted at /result, using toolio.UntrustedFields

criteria.condition: --op read is selected
criteria.action: include a rendered field (tagged trust:"external") in the result containing the thread text as toolio.RenderThread produces it
set the envelope's summary to a sentence naming the operation and target, e.g. "issue: created acme/widgets#43"

criteria.condition: --detail summary (the default) is selected
criteria.action: return a summary view for list that drops issue bodies and for read that drops the rendered thread text; all other operations shall return the full result as the summary view

requirements.title: Dry-run, artifacts, side effects and timings
requirements.rationale: The tool is a primitive with one forge call; its dry-run, artifacts, side effects, timings and empty next follow from the envelope contract.

criteria.condition: --dry-run is set on a write operation
criteria.action: resolve the target, build the client, check authentication, and stop before making the forge request; report result.would_write (the request struct) with dry_run true and record no side effect

criteria.condition: --dry-run is set on a read operation
criteria.action: execute the read exactly as without --dry-run

criteria.condition: a create, create-pr, comment or merge operation succeeds
criteria.action: emit the corresponding artifact: create yields {kind: issue, url, number}, create-pr yields {kind: pull_request, url, number}, comment yields {kind: comment, url}, merge yields {kind: commit, sha, branch}; other operations yield only report_file and events_file artifacts

record one side_effects[] entry per forge write using actions create_issue, update_issue, comment, open_pr, close_issue, add_labels, remove_label, create_label, review_comment, merge_pr, close_pr as appropriate, with kind never set on an issue write
record one timings[] entry {kind: "forge", name: <op>} per forge call including implied reads, and always set the next array in the envelope to empty

requirements.title: Error categories, exit codes and warnings
requirements.rationale: A skill that can branch on not_found, conflict and rate_limited without parsing a message, and that is told rate_limited is retryable, is the point of a decidable envelope.

criteria.action: use exit codes 0 (success), 1 (failure) and 2 (usage error), and list exactly those three in the --schema exit_codes map

criteria.condition: a forge call returns an error
criteria.action: map the error to error.category as follows: issuex.IsNotFound → "not_found" (not retryable), issuex.IsConflict → "conflict" (not retryable), issuex.IsRateLimited → "rate_limited" (retryable), issuex.IsNoToken → "auth" (not retryable), any other HTTPError or transport error → "forge" (not retryable); report the stage as "call"
return true for "rate_limited" in addition to the existing "api" and "aborted" categories

criteria.condition: ListComments or ReadIssue hit the 500-comment cap (CommentList.Truncated or IssueThread.Truncated is true)
criteria.action: record warning code comments_truncated at stage call with severity low

criteria.condition: ListIssues returns IssueList.Incomplete as true
criteria.action: record warning code list_incomplete at stage call with severity low

criteria.condition: ReadIssue returns a thread with CommentsErr set
criteria.action: record the existing comments_unreadable warning

requirements.title: Shell changes to internal/toolio
requirements.rationale: The envelope, exit codes, report file, events, --output and --schema are what make this a fifth tool rather than a fifth way to call a forge; they stay one implementation, with a split so the model-run flags are optional.

criteria.action: support declaring a no-model-phase execution path; for such an App, execute shall run PreCheck, resolve --dir to a directory, and call Exec with Deps whose Workspace, Runner, Model and Index are nil and whose Forge the tool builds itself, without classifying an input, resolving a model, or building a runner

split Register so that model-run flags (--model, --vendor, --effort, --max-turns, --budget, --phase-timeout, --total-budget, --context, --trust-project, --show-text, --input-kind, --preflight, --repo-map-tokens) are registered by a separate method; the four existing tools shall call both methods and see no change in their flag sets, exit codes, envelopes or --schema golden files

add "issue" to toolOrder and toolFlags, and attribute the model-run flags to the four tools (triage, fix, spec, impl) in the unsupported-flag table so that passing a model-run flag to issue names them

correct the SinglePhase field comment on App and the SinglePhaseBounds method comment on Common from "issue" to "triage"; correct the docs/cli.md warning-codes table entries attributing tool_errors and rejected_path_calls to "issue" to "triage"

criteria.condition: the tool is issue
criteria.action: emit a run_start event that omits the model field and sets input_kind to the target's form: one of url, ref, repo, number or default
update the Envelope.Tool field description and run_start event documentation to name five tools: spec, triage, fix, impl and issue

execution_paths.title: Read an issue by URL and display its contents

steps.action: runs issue --op read https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/42
parses the URL via issuex.ParseIssueURL to obtain an IssueRef with host, repo and number
builds a forge client via issuex.NewWithOptions using the URL's host
calls ReadIssue on the client with the parsed IssueRef
returns the IssueThread with issue metadata and comments
renders the thread via toolio.RenderThread, tags external fields, computes untrusted_fields, and emits the envelope with result.read, result.rendered and exit code 0

execution_paths.title: Create an issue on the forge

steps.action: runs issue --op create --title 'Bug: login broken' --body 'Steps to reproduce...' --label bug acme/widgets
parses acme/widgets via issuex.ParseRepo as a repository target, validates --title is present, checks --body and --label against the create operation in PreCheck
builds an authenticated forge client, verifies Authenticated() is true
calls CreateIssue with the title, body, and labels
creates the issue and returns the Issue with number and URL
records a create_issue side effect, emits an issue artifact {kind: issue, url, number}, and writes the envelope with exit code 0 and summary 'issue: created acme/widgets#43'

execution_paths.title: Dry-run a write stops before the forge request

steps.action: runs issue --op close --body 'Resolved' --dry-run https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/42
parses the URL, builds the authenticated client, resolves the target
stops before calling CloseIssue, sets result.would_write to the request struct and result.dry_run to true
emits the envelope with exit code 0, no side_effects, and dry_run true in the result

execution_paths.title: Write operation refused for missing credentials

steps.action: runs issue --op comment --body 'test' acme/widgets#10 in an environment with no GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN
parses the target, builds a client whose Authenticated() returns false
detects unauthenticated write, refuses before any forge call
emits the envelope with exit code 1, error.category 'auth', error.retryable false, and fix_hint.env listing GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN and GITLAB_TOKEN

execution_paths.title: Model-run flag rejected with accepting-tools message

steps.action: runs issue --op read --model ADVANCED https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/1
flag parse fails because --model is not registered; unsupportedFlagMessage looks up --model in the toolFlags table
emits the envelope with exit code 2, error.category 'usage', and an error message naming the tools that accept --model

execution_paths.title: List issues in the repository detected from origin

steps.action: runs issue --op list --state open --limit 50 in a git checkout whose origin is github.com/acme/widgets
detects no positional, resolves the origin remote via issuex.DetectRepo, builds a forge client
calls ListIssues with state=open and limit=50
returns an IssueList with up to 50 open issues
emits the envelope with result.list, exit code 0, and records a forge timing entry
